ratio_target: four local joint hypotheses then one independently validated pairwise interaction hypothesis
first_decision: Launch local1 after CPU optimizer-scope checks; no separate timing screen for existing numerical implementation. Inspect its curve and measured updates before the next local choice.
limits: One checkpoint gradient sample is diagnostic evidence, not a causal mechanism proof.
Raw dense gradient magnitudes are not directly comparable with routed gradients because activation/routing and parameter populations differ.
Coefficient-relative updates are per odd Adam application, while projection-relative updates occur every update.
No new shared/model-wide setting, data, precision, width, rank, or control cohort.
All proposals are new joint configurations; historical rejected scalar recipes and all-KS3 queues remain discarded.
exploratory: Existing CPU prototype retains independent rank-one pathways and adds zero-initialized bounded adjacent interactions. GPU output/input/weight/geometry/coupling gradients and initialization equivalence must pass before its convergence trial.
